title: TensorPlate Failure Reason Taxonomy
description: Operator-visible failure reason taxonomy (V01-E12-F03). Normalises local failure reasons across the agent transaction status, serving worker inference errors, backend/adapter failures, Python/PyTorch sidecar lifecycle, worker supervision, and observability heartbeat. Failure reasons classify typed `error_code` values so CLI consumers can render explanations without parsing free-form messages. Each reason maps to exactly one `error_code`; new reasons append rather than rename to keep the wire format stable.

reason.description: Stable failure reason code. The set is union-stable; post-v0.1.0 additions append.

category.description: Coarse grouping used by CLI rendering and metric aggregation. Bounded to keep label cardinality finite.

severity.description: Severity hint for CLI rendering. Sinks may downsample lower severities under backpressure (V01-E12-F06).

retryable.description: Coarse hint to operators and agent retry logic. The agent does not auto-retry permission or bundle-integrity failures.

error_code.description: Mapping to the existing `protocol/schemas/error.json` taxonomy. Each reason maps to exactly one code; CLI consumers can render the reason and still surface the code for V01-E15 grep assertions.

detail.description: Optional bounded human-readable detail. Producers MUST redact absolute paths, environment values, and credentials before emitting.

correlation_id.description: Optional correlation id (V01-E12-F02) tying the failure to logs and metrics.
